# fianu_target (Resource)

Manages a Fianu deployment target — a concrete cloud destination (EKS cluster, Cloud Run service, Lambda region) bound to one or more environments. Gates evaluate deployment events against a target's environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A target is a concrete cloud destination bound to one or more environments.
# `environments` takes a path or a UUID; paths resolve server-side at deploy.

resource "fianu_target" "eks_prod" {
  path = "targets.eks_prod"
  name = "EKS Production"

  detail = {
    description    = "Primary production Kubernetes cluster."
    cloud_provider = "AWS"
    type           = "kubernetes"
    service        = "eks"
    region         = "us-east-1"
    tags           = ["prod", "pci"]
  }

  environments = [
    { environment = fianu_environment.production.path },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `detail` (Attributes) Target payload — what and where this deployment destination is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail))
- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments this target deploys into. At least one is required — the server rejects a target with none. Each entry takes an environment path or UUID; paths are resolved server-side at deploy time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `name` (String) Display name of the entity.
- `path` (String) Human-readable entity key (slug). Immutable — changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `aliases` (List of String) Alternative names this target is known by. Useful when a deployment pipeline reports a different identifier than the target's `name`.
- `children` (List of String) Child entity references. Server-derived; do not author manually.
- `documentation` (Attributes List) Documentation links surfaced alongside the entity in the Console. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documentation))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form key/value metadata. Server may augment with creator/timestamps.
- `parents` (List of String) Parent entity references. Server populates them from cross-entity relationships.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier in the form `<entity_type>/<entity_key>` (e.g., `control/payment-service-sast`). Used by `terraform import`.
- `uuid` (String) Server-generated UUID. Stable across versions of the entity.
- `version` (Attributes) Server-managed version envelope. Every partial update bumps `semantic` and regenerates `uuid` + `timestamp` server-side, so the object is NOT pinned via UseStateForUnknown — plans correctly show `(known after apply)` on any change, and Create/Update refetch the entity post-deploy to populate from server truth. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--version))

### Nested Schema for `detail`

Optional:

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider, e.g. `AWS`, `GCP`, `Azure`.

- `region` (String) Cloud region, e.g. `us-east-1`.
- `service` (String) Cloud service name, e.g. `eks`, `cloudrun`, `lambda`.
- `solution` (String) Solution identifier this target belongs to.
- `tags` (List of String) Free-form tags.
- `type` (String) Classification of the target, e.g. `kubernetes`, `serverless`.

### Nested Schema for `version`

Read-Only:

- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. May be mutated by server-side workflows.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status. May be mutated by server-side workflows.
- `timestamp` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the version was created.
- `uuid` (String) Per-version UUID. Changes whenever the server creates a new version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fianu_target.eks_prod 'target/targets.eks_prod'
```
